name: Hotel Olympia
beschreibung: Hotel Olympia enjoys a peaceful alpine setting in Axams, just outside Innsbruck. The property skillfully merges traditional Tyrolean architecture with modern guest amenities. A standout feature is the wellness area with an indoor pool and sauna complex. Half-board includes a generous breakfast buffet and regional evening dinners. The hotel serves as an exceptional base for hiking in summer and skiing at the Olympic resort Axamer Lizum in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Olympia in Axams near Innsbruck features an indoor swimming pool, a sauna wellness area, regional half-board dining, and proximity to Axamer Lizum.
